reference_basis.name: ULTRA public-aircraft benchmark used by this project
reference_basis.propulsion_rating_note: The public benchmark values define aircraft mass, fuel, geometry, and mission scale; a public engine rating or hybrid battery/motor rating is not specified here.

sizing_note: The 1.20 multipliers are project-selected preliminary sizing margins applied to the existing aggregate estimates. They are not ULTRA-published component ratings and are not calibrated hardware data.
